senses.gloss: विथ् (cf. √ वेथ् and विध्) cl. 1. Ā. वेथते, to ask, beg, Dhātup. ii, 32.
विथुर॑ mf(आ)n. (√ व्यथ्) staggering, tottering, RV.; AV.
विथुर्य Nom. P. ˚य॑ति, to stagger, totter, RV.
विथूति-स्तोत्र (?) n. N. of a Stotra, Cat.
विथ्या f. a species of plant (= गोजिह्वा), L.
वीथी—कृत mfn. placed or arranged in rows, MBh.
वीथी—मार्ग m. one of an elephant's paces, L.
वीथ्य्—अङ्ग n. a division of the Vīthi drama (described as a kind of dialogue consisting in quibble, equivoque, jest, abuse, and the like), W.
